subject: Gate decomposition & evidence matrix for evaluation runway
messages:
From: Alex Mendez <cto@finovate.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finovate.com
Date: 2026-10-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Gate decomposition and evidence matrix for Redwood trial

Hey Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the runtime performance looks promising. As we start a short evaluation with product + security, we need a concise decomposition of the MAP that maps each security/compliance gate to the artifact we should expect and an owner at Redwood. Specifically we need clarity on: 

- SOC 2: scope (which Trust Services Criteria), expected attestation artifact, and timing for receiving your latest report.
- SIG/CAIQ: full questionnaire timeline and whether you provide a pre-filled CAIQ.
- DPA: we have a few data residency and subprocessors carveouts; can you confirm your standard redline turnaround and a DPA draft?
- Data retention and deletion: default retention windows for embeddings/logs and the technical process for deletion on request.

We'd like a simple evidence matrix (column headers: gate, artifact, delivery ETA, owner, comments) so our security team can review and slot items into our internal acceptance sprint. Can you also include any sample audit logs or a pointer to the SOC 2 report (if public or a stub)?

Target timeline from our side: evaluation kickoff Oct 19, final decision by Nov 16. If you can get the map + evidence matrix by EOD Oct 13 that'd help us schedule the security sprint.

Appreciate it — cc'd our security inbox so they see the ask directly.

—Alex
Alex Mendez
CTO, Finovate Payments
alex.mendez@finovate.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mendez <cto@finovate.com>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Gate decomposition and evidence matrix for Redwood trial

Alex —

Thanks, and glad the demo hit the mark. Attached is an initial evidence matrix and a short summary below. We can expand rows if your security team wants more granularity.

High-level MAP decomposition (draft):

1) Policy & Attestation
   - Gate: SOC 2 Type II (security + availability)
   - Artifact: SOC 2 Type II attestation report (PDF) + management response summary
   - ETA: we can provide our 2025 attestation PDF by Oct 13 (attached stub)
   - Owner: Redwood Security (Soojin)

2) Questionnaire
   - Gate: SIG/CAIQ
   - Artifact: pre-filled CAIQ + supporting evidence links (controls mapping)
   - ETA: pre-filled CAIQ in 3 business days after you share any custom scope notes
   - Owner: Redwood Security (Soojin)

3) Contractual / Legal
   - Gate: DPA & data residency addendum
   - Artifact: Draft DPA with redline; list of subprocessors and KMS/HSM overview
   - ETA: Draft redline v1 in 2 business days; turnaround on counter-redline typically 3–5 business days
   - Owner: Redwood Legal & Sales (Stephanie + Marcus)

4) Technical Assurance
   - Gate: Evidence of data handling, retention, and deletion processes
   - Artifact: retention policy doc, sample audit logs, deletion runbook, and an export+erase checklist
   - ETA: retention doc + sample logs by Oct 13; deletion runbook by Oct 16
   - Owner: Redwood Product (Marcus)

5) Operational Readiness
   - Gate: Monitoring, incident response, and SLA commitments for dedicated evaluation capacity
   - Artifact: Ops runbook, per-route latency and cost projections, escalation contacts
   - ETA: ops runbook by Oct 16
   - Owner: Redwood Ops (Marcus)

Attached: redwood_evidence_matrix_v1.csv (CSV with rows per gate). Also attached a non-sensitive SOC2 stub: SOC2_Attestation_2025.pdf (summary page only).

Next steps:
- We will drop the pre-filled CAIQ into the Drive link below and flag rows that may need follow-up.
- Suggest 30 min sync with your security team on Oct 14 to walk the matrix and accept scoping assumptions — does 10am PT work?

If you want us to accelerate any artifact (e.g., full SOC 2 package rather than the stub) we can route that as a priority; just let us know which items are blocking.

Best,

Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Date: 2026-10-14T15:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Gate decomposition and evidence matrix for Redwood trial

Alex / team —

Thanks for the note. I wanted to add a few security clarifications so your reviewers have the specifics up front. Quoting Stephanie below for context.

On Tue, Oct 12, 2026 at 11:05 AM Stephanie Nguyen wrote: "Attached: redwood_evidence_matrix_v1.csv..."

Clarifications / specifics:
- SOC 2
  - Scope: Security and Availability controls by default; we can include Confidentiality upon request (adds ~2–3 days to artifact gathering if you require expanded scope).
  - Attestation: our last third-party Type II report covers Jan–Dec 2025; we will provide redacted sections that show control descriptions and test results. Full report is typically available under NDA.

- CAIQ / SIG
  - We provide a pre-populated CAIQ that maps questions to our internal control evidence (links to Drive items, screenshots, runbook snippets). Expect the pre-filled CAIQ + links within 3 business days.

- Data retention / deletion
  - Default: embeddings cache/temporary logs retained 90 days; anonymized telemetry 1 year.
  - Deletion on request: we run a two-step deletion (logical view purge + background storage cleanup). For regulated customers we can configure retention windows per account and provide a deletion ticket with a traceable audit trail.
  - Point-in-time deletes for inference artifacts: ETA 24–72 hours depending on shard/region and whether archive tiers are in play.

- Residency & key management
  - We support region pinning (us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1) for evaluation; for production we can provide dedicated VPCs.
  - KMS: customer-managed keys supported via AWS KMS; HSM options through partner integrations — we can provide KMS architecture diagram on request.

I've uploaded a compact evidence bundle (non-sensitive pieces) to the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-finovate-evidence — that'll be completed before our Oct 14 sync.

If Oct 14 10am PT still works, I'll join and walk the controls mapping.

—Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Stephanie / Soojin —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the matrix. The clarifications from Soojin address most of our questions. A few follow-ups before we lock the kickoff: 

- Can you confirm the SOC 2 PDF you're sharing is a redacted summary? Our legal team will request the unredacted report under NDA if needed.
- For DPA: please send the Draft_DPA_Redline_v2.docx to procurement; we want to run a parallel internal review. Can you also confirm your subprocessors list and approximate timing for signing?
- Data retention: we need a hard commitment on the default retention window for evaluation data (if 90 days is a default, will you accept a 30-day retention for the trial if we request it in the DPA)?

Assuming those answers are OK, we are comfortable with Oct 19 kickoff and the security sprint timing. Please send the DocuSign link for the DPA when ready and drop the CAIQ in the Drive.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Stephanie: share Draft_DPA_Redline_v2.docx to procurement@finovate.com and the DocuSign link.
- Soojin: confirm SOC2 delivery & push CAIQ to Drive.
- Marcus: provide deletion runbook by Oct 16 evening if possible.

Thanks — we will hold Oct 19 as kickoff.

—Alex

CTO, Finovate Payments
